## Storm Types per Year

The plot below shows the count of each storm type per year (tropical depressions, tropical storms, and hurricanes) based on the `storms` dataset from the `dplyr` package.

```{r}
#| label: plot-storms
#| fig-cap: "Number of storms by type per year from 1975 to the present."
storms %>%
  filter(status %in% c("tropical depression", "tropical storm", "hurricane")) %>%
  mutate(status = factor(status, levels = c("tropical depression", "tropical storm", "hurricane"))) %>%
  distinct(year, name, status) %>%
  count(year, status) %>%
  complete(year, status, fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = n, fill = status)) +
  geom_area(alpha = 0.85, color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "tropical depression" = "#90e0ef", # light blue
      "tropical storm" = "#f4a261",      # orange
      "hurricane" = "#9b2226"             # dark red
    ),
    labels = c("Tropical Depression", "Tropical Storm", "Hurricane")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Storm Counts by Type Per Year",
    subtitle = "Historical trends of tropical depressions, tropical storms, and hurricanes",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Storm Count",
    fill = "Storm Status"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(face = "italic", size = 12, hjust = 0.5, color = "grey40"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```
